purpose: Locked frozen-8DNA evaluation of the teaset part-configuration trajectory. Locked after the GT-only design (v2) and the correspondence tests passed, before any moved-state neural render.
camera_lighting_materials: upstream scenes/teaset get_scene(res) unchanged: camera theta=60 phi=160 r=2.5 target (0,0.2,0) fov 35; envmap textures/envmap.exr rotated 90 deg about y; rough Ni_palik conductors (alpha 0.05 tray/teapot, 0.1 milk pot/tin), two-sided

renderer.neural: upstream neuralpath, max_depth 10, rr_depth 5, LoopRecord off, VCallRecord on (runtime workaround, see ednalib)

roles.T1: relation-preserving motion control (failed the low-interaction GT criterion: 55% of T3)

mode_roles.upstream: T0: released baseline; moved states: coordinate-mismatch diagnostic (current-world queries), not a transport result

rois: gt_design/v2/rois_<state>.npz from teaset_gt_states.py with protocol/teaset_gt_design_v2.json (interaction, tray, far, mover; surface-corresponded)
metrics: per ROI and mode: physical change GT(Ti)-GT(T0), model change 8DNA(Ti)-8DNA(T0), model error 8DNA(Ti)-GT(Ti), T0 error on the same surfaces, linear response (gain = <dN,dG>/<dG,dG>, correlation); full-image error with SSIM

decision_rule.failure_in_state: for a relation-change state (T1b, T2, T3): interaction-ROI display-MAE error rises by at least 25% over the same-surface T0 error AND the model reproduces less than half of the physical change (linear response gain < 0.5)
decision_rule.control_check: the same error rise in T1 (relation preserved) must be below 25% of the T0 error for a failure to be attributed to the relation change rather than to generic movement/query handling
decision_rule.classification: CROSS-MODEL GEOMETRY-CONFIGURATION FAILURE OBSERVED if failure_in_state holds for at least one relation-change state and control_check holds; NO MEANINGFUL FAILURE UNDER TESTED REGIME if it holds for none; if it holds but control_check fails, the result is reported as failure with generic-movement confound (secondary UNRESOLVED or IMPLEMENTATION-LIKE)
decision_rule.secondary: TRANSPORT-LIKE if the error rise concentrates where GT interreflection changed (interaction/tray) while the far ROI stays within 25% of its T0 error and fixed vs attached envelopes agree; LOCAL/SPATIAL-LIKE if the error follows the moved part's own surface or depends strongly on the envelope/query convention; IMPLEMENTATION-LIKE if T1 fails; otherwise UNRESOLVED
